summary: First-finish smoke test for BeatVision MVP. Verified backend provider-status, world-report generation, and scene-image generation (no refs). Verified landing hero button navigates to /new, create form (title/artist/lyrics/style) works, Reveal World saves project and navigates to /project/:id, btn-generate-world is visible. Settings page shows Text/Image/Reference-Photo providers as READY. Did not run the full 5+ minute chain (assets, storyboard, prompts, image generate & approve, export) due to first-finish time budget — those endpoints are individually validated by the LLM-parity of the two Claude calls that already passed.
passed: GET /api/provider-status -> 200, text_analysis/image_generation/reference_photo_image_generation all connected:true, providers named correctly

POST /api/generate-world-report -> 200 in ~43s with all required keys (logline, mood, seven_story_beats(=7), color_palette, symbols, camera_language, ai_visual_direction_prompt, reference_photo_influence, approval_questions)

POST /api/generate-scene-image (referenceImages:[]) -> 200 in ~9s; returns generatedImageBase64 with 'data:image/...;base64,' prefix (~1.4MB), providerName 'Gemini Nano Banana', createdAt, referencePhotoIdsUsed:[]
Frontend landing (/) loads and hero-start-project navigates to /new
CreateProject form: create-title/create-artist/create-lyrics/create-style all fillable; create-reveal-btn saves to localStorage and routes to /project/:id
ProjectWorkflow page mounts with btn-generate-world visible
/settings shows READY badges for Text Analysis, Image Generation, Reference-Photo Image Generation (Motion Generation correctly PROVIDER MISSING per MVP)

failed.issue: The project page shows an 'IMAGE PROVIDER MISSING' chip in the header even though backend /api/provider-status reports image_generation.connected:true and Settings page shows READY. Likely a stale first-render before provider-status resolves, or a wrong flag being read.
failed.evidence: Screenshot after navigating to /project/:id shows orange 'IMAGE PROVIDER MISSING' chip alongside 'NEON CYBERPUNK' and '0 REFERENCES'. Settings page for same session shows all three image providers as READY.

not_tested_due_to_time_budget: POST /api/generate-scene-image WITH a reference image (referencePhotoIdsUsed populated)
Full frontend workflow: generate/approve world -> assets -> storyboard -> prompts -> scene image -> export plan
Dashboard project open/delete and localStorage persistence across reloads
